Transport for NSW (TfNSW) invites suitably experienced tenderers to undertake the construction of Macquarie Park Precinct & Bus Interchange project.
Transport for NSW (TfNSW) have planned the construction upgrade of the Macquarie Park Precinct and Bus Interchange (MPPBI) project, which is located in the suburb of Macquarie Park, within the City of Ryde. The works are split across three main areas, refer to diagram below.
The upgrade of Herring Road for a new bus interchange and plaza area known as “Site 1”, the construction of the a new bus layover facility known as “Site 2” and the construction of a new Waterloo Road vehicle exit from Macquarie Centre known as “Site 3”. All sites are located in Macquarie Park which is within the City of Ryde Local Government Area.
The Sites are approximately 18 km from Sydney CBD by road, and the works are to be constructed within and upon an operating road and adjacent to live traffic. The works under the contract is to be carried out with the least possible disruption to traffic and access to nearby residences and businesses.
Tender closing time and date is 3.00 pm on Friday 11 September 2026.
This is an open tender.
A pre-tender meeting will be held at 10:00am Thursday, 9 July 2026, 7 Harvest Street, Macquarie Park NSW. Attendance is mandatory to submit a conforming tender. Any coordination for this may be made through the Contact Officer at MPPBI@transport.nsw.gov.au
All tenderers must comply with the Transport Statement of Business Ethics through the procurement process and any subsequent contract period.
All tenderers must comply with the NSW Government Procurement Policy Framework, NSW Government Supplier Code of Conduct and New South Wales Industrial Relations Guidelines: Building and Construction Procurement.
This Project is jointly funded by the Australian and NSW Governments.
It is a requirement for this Project that the successful contractor be accredited under the Australian Government Work Health and Safety Accreditation Scheme (the Scheme) at the time of entering into the contract for ‘building work’ for the Project and must maintain accreditation under the Scheme while the ‘building work’ is being carried out. Information on the Scheme is available on the Australian Government website at www.fsc.gov.au.
